agencies.name: Office of Consumer Device Data
agencies.description: Fictional federal office that regulates how makers of consumer devices collect, keep and share data.

agencies.name: Bureau of Small Business Records
agencies.description: Fictional bureau that sets record-keeping and reporting rules for small businesses and practices.

agencies.name: Office of Outdoor Lighting Standards
agencies.description: Fictional office that sets efficiency, glare and dark-sky standards for outdoor lighting.

dockets.title: Default Settings for Location History on Fitness Devices
dockets.summary: The Office proposes that location history on fitness devices be off by default for new accounts.
dockets.supplementary_information: Comment is sought on exemptions for safety features that rely on location.

corrections.text: Correction: a date in the DATES section was printed incorrectly; the closing date stated in CivicDesk is authoritative.

dockets.title: Correlated Color Temperature Limits for Street Lighting
dockets.summary: The Office proposes a 3000 kelvin ceiling for new street lighting.
dockets.supplementary_information: Exemptions for sports facilities are discussed in section 5.

corrections.text: Correction: a date in the DATES section was printed incorrectly; the closing date stated in CivicDesk is authoritative.

dockets.title: Disclosure of Sensor Accuracy Ranges
dockets.summary: The Office proposes that device makers publish the accuracy range of heart-rate and oxygen sensors in plain language.
dockets.supplementary_information: The Office asks how ranges should be measured and whether they belong on packaging or in the app.

history.detail: Extended at the request of commenters

dockets.title: Electronic Record Retention for Small Practices
dockets.summary: The Bureau proposes a seven-year retention standard for patient and client records kept by practices with fewer than ten employees.
dockets.supplementary_information: The proposal would allow encrypted cloud storage and asks how long records must stay retrievable after a practice closes.

history.detail: Extended at the request of commenters

dockets.title: Shielding Requirements for Commercial Parking Lots
dockets.summary: The Office proposes full-cutoff fixtures for parking lots above a size threshold.
dockets.supplementary_information: Comment is sought on retrofit timelines.

history.detail: Extended at the request of commenters

dockets.title: Data Portability Between Wearable Platforms
dockets.summary: The Office proposes a common export format for daily activity summaries so that users can move between platforms.
dockets.supplementary_information: The proposed format covers steps, distance, active minutes and sleep stages; raw sensor streams are excluded.

corrections.text: Correction: a date in the DATES section was printed incorrectly; the closing date stated in CivicDesk is authoritative.

dockets.title: Curfew Dimming for Outdoor Signage
dockets.summary: The Office proposes that illuminated signs dim after midnight in residential zones.
dockets.supplementary_information: The Office asks about safety exceptions.

dockets.title: Children's Accounts on Consumer Health Devices
dockets.summary: The Office proposes stricter defaults and parental controls for accounts of users under thirteen.
dockets.supplementary_information: Comment is sought on age verification that does not itself collect more data.

dockets.title: Efficiency Standards for Residential Path Lighting
dockets.summary: The Office proposes minimum efficacy for residential path and porch lights.
dockets.supplementary_information: Solar fixtures are addressed separately.

corrections.text: Correction: a date in the DATES section was printed incorrectly; the closing date stated in CivicDesk is authoritative.

dockets.title: Notice of Data Breach Timelines for Device Makers
dockets.summary: The Office proposes a thirty-day notice requirement for breaches involving sensor data.
dockets.supplementary_information: The Office asks whether the clock should start at discovery or at confirmation.

dockets.title: Glare Measurement Method for Sports Fields
dockets.summary: The Office proposes a standard glare measurement method for sports-field lighting.
dockets.supplementary_information: The proposal asks which measurement positions are representative.

dockets.title: Research Partner Agreements for De-identified Data
dockets.summary: The Office proposes minimum contract terms for sharing de-identified device data with research partners.
dockets.supplementary_information: Terms include a prohibition on re-identification attempts and an audit right.

corrections.text: Correction: a date in the DATES section was printed incorrectly; the closing date stated in CivicDesk is authoritative.

history.detail: Extended at the request of commenters

dockets.title: Dark-Sky Protection Near Observatories
dockets.summary: The Office proposes stricter limits within fifteen miles of observatories.
dockets.supplementary_information: Comment is sought on the radius.

history.detail: Extended at the request of commenters

dockets.title: Sleep Tracking Claims and Substantiation
dockets.summary: The Office proposes that sleep-stage claims be substantiated by validation studies.
dockets.supplementary_information: The Office asks what study designs are adequate for consumer devices.

history.detail: Extended at the request of commenters

dockets.title: Motion-Activated Lighting in Public Parks
dockets.summary: The Office proposes motion activation for park lighting after closing hours.
dockets.supplementary_information: The Office asks about maintenance costs.

dockets.title: Account Deletion Standards for Device Platforms
dockets.summary: The Office proposes that deleting an account removes associated sensor data within thirty days.
dockets.supplementary_information: Backups and legal holds are addressed in section 4.

dockets.title: Labeling of Outdoor Fixtures for Light Pollution
dockets.summary: The Office proposes a label stating upward light output.
dockets.supplementary_information: Testing procedures are in the supporting analysis.

dockets.title: Interoperable Alerts for Abnormal Heart Rhythm Notifications
dockets.summary: The Office proposes a common format for rhythm notifications shared with clinicians.
dockets.supplementary_information: Comment is sought on false-positive handling.

dockets.title: Advertising Based on Wearable Data
dockets.summary: The Office proposes to prohibit targeted advertising based on health sensor data without separate consent.
dockets.supplementary_information: The proposal distinguishes activity data from health inferences.

dockets.title: Firmware Update Transparency
dockets.summary: The Office proposes that device makers publish release notes for firmware changes that alter sensor behavior.
dockets.supplementary_information: The Office asks about the level of detail required.

dockets.title: Secondary Use of Workout Data by Employers
dockets.summary: The Office proposes limits on employer access to employees' wearable workout data in wellness programs.
dockets.supplementary_information: Comment is sought on aggregate reporting thresholds.

dockets.title: Simplified Quarterly Reporting for Sole Proprietors
dockets.summary: The Bureau proposes a one-page quarterly report for sole proprietors below a revenue threshold.
dockets.supplementary_information: The threshold and the treatment of seasonal businesses are open questions.

corrections.text: Correction: a date in the DATES section was printed incorrectly; the closing date stated in CivicDesk is authoritative.

dockets.title: Digital Signature Acceptance for Client Agreements
dockets.summary: The Bureau proposes to accept digital signatures on client agreements kept by small practices.
dockets.supplementary_information: Comment is sought on identity assurance levels.

history.detail: Extended at the request of commenters

dockets.title: Reporting of Municipal Lighting Inventories
dockets.summary: The Office proposes an annual inventory report for municipalities.
dockets.supplementary_information: A spreadsheet template is a supporting document.

history.detail: Extended at the request of commenters

dockets.title: Record-Keeping for Appointment-Based Services
dockets.summary: The Bureau proposes minimum appointment records for service businesses, including cancellations and no-shows.
dockets.supplementary_information: The proposal asks whether fee disputes should be part of the record.

dockets.title: Deletion Requests from Former Clients
dockets.summary: The Bureau proposes a process and a thirty-day deadline for deleting former clients' records on request, subject to retention law.
dockets.supplementary_information: The Bureau asks how the deadline should interact with clinical retention requirements.

dockets.title: Backup and Recovery Standards for Practice Records
dockets.summary: The Bureau proposes an annual recovery test for practices that keep records electronically.
dockets.supplementary_information: Comment is sought on what counts as a successful test.

dockets.title: Plain-Language Privacy Notices for Small Practices
dockets.summary: The Bureau proposes a model privacy notice that practices may adopt.
dockets.supplementary_information: The model notice is published as a supporting document.

dockets.title: Shared Record Systems Among Independent Practitioners
dockets.summary: The Bureau proposes rules for practitioners who share one record system.
dockets.supplementary_information: Access logging and separation of client lists are addressed.

dockets.title: Cybersecurity Labeling for Consumer Wearables
dockets.summary: The Office proposes a voluntary cybersecurity label for consumer wearables that states update support periods and encryption at rest.
dockets.supplementary_information: The label would be awarded after third-party testing; the Office seeks comment on the testing scope and label format.

dockets.title: Trail Lighting Standards in Wildlife Corridors
dockets.summary: The Office proposes amber lighting and seasonal curfews in wildlife corridors.
dockets.supplementary_information: The Office asks how corridors should be designated.

dockets.title: Record Transfer When a Practice Changes Hands
dockets.summary: The Bureau proposes a notice to clients and a transfer inventory when a practice is sold.
dockets.supplementary_information: The proposal asks about timing and client consent.

dockets.title: Retention and Sharing of Consumer Wearable Sensor Data
dockets.summary: The Office proposes to permit makers of consumer wearables to retain raw step, heart-rate and sleep sensor data for three years after collection and to share de-identified sensor data with research partners by default, with an opt-out available in device settings.
dockets.supplementary_information: The proposal sets a three-year retention ceiling, defines de-identification by removal of direct identifiers, and asks whether small clinics and individual practitioners who use patient wearable data in care should have a defined deletion path when care ends.

dockets.title: Retention of Wearable-Derived Measurements in Client Files
dockets.summary: The Bureau proposes that measurements imported from client wearables be kept only for the episode of service unless the client agrees otherwise.
dockets.supplementary_information: The proposal cross-references the OCDD wearable retention rulemaking.

dockets.title: Reporting of Data Incidents by Small Practices
dockets.summary: The Bureau proposes a simplified incident report for practices with fewer than ten employees.
dockets.supplementary_information: The Bureau asks whether a telephone report should suffice for the first notice.

dockets.title: Bridge and Waterfront Lighting Guidance
dockets.summary: The Office proposes guidance for lighting over water to limit reflection.
dockets.supplementary_information: Comment is sought on whether guidance should become a standard.

documents.title: Retention analysis and small-practice impact, OCDD-2026-0031

comments.text: As a two-person physical therapy clinic we keep client records for seven years already; the proposal should say plainly that encrypted cloud storage counts, because most small practices cannot run their own servers. Retrievability after a practice closes should be limited to the retention period, not indefinite.

A thirty-day deadline for deleting a former client's records is workable for a small practice if it is clear which records clinical retention law still requires us to keep; the rule should list those categories so that we can answer the client in one message.
Amber trail lighting with a seasonal curfew is a good balance for the river corridor near our town; please keep an exception for the trailhead parking area where people load equipment after dark.
